items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: I had to tell him how much I thought of that tune. It was really great. We became friends after that.

ctx.x: I just love that chart, and I said to this publisher, how can I get in touch with him, and he said he's staying at Hotel so and so. Do you have his number? Yeah. I called him from the office right there, you don't know me, my name is George Handy, I just heard your chart of "Bahia" and I think it's one of the most marvelous--that's how we met, on the phone.
I had to tell him how much I thought of that tune. It was really great. We became friends after that.
Do you know Joel Kaye? I'm sure you know Joel Kaye.
